entry.whatSheDid: Providing one-on-one support to students who want extra help getting ahead in their schoolwork.
entry.whoItHelped: Students looking for support outside of regular class time.
entry.whatSheLearned: Doing private tutoring has taught me how to simplify complex ideas and build my mentoring skills. Communication has taught me to explain difficult content in a way that fits the student's understanding — communication isn't just about how you convey content to a student, it's also about motivating them and pushing them beyond their current understanding. Constructive feedback has taught me how to identify mistakes and prevent students from getting overwhelmed by a question or a method. Strategic questioning has helped me make sure that during the one-hour tutoring session, it isn't me talking the whole time — it leaves space for the student to ask or answer questions.
